title: sicefulPlayingCards
description: Resource pack that adds a full deck of playing cards by renaming paper.
body:
A resourcepack that adds a full deck of custom playing card textures and a full deck of UNO cards, for use on your SMPs or singleplayer worlds.

How it works:
use Anvil to rename Paper
 - name format for standard cards is a combination of card number followed by suit
 - name format for UNO is a combination of card number followed by colour

Examples:
 - two of hearts: 2H (value of two -> 2, suit of hearts -> H)
 - king of spades: KS (value of king -> K, suit of spades -> S)
 - blue pick-up 2: P2B (value of pick-up 2 -> P2, colour of blue -> B

Full list of item names:
-Playing Cards-
 - AC, 2C, 3C, 4C, 5C, 6C, 7C, 8C, 9C, 10C, JC, QC, KC
 - AD, 2D, 3D, 4D, 5D, 6D, 7D, 8D, 9D, 10D, JD, QD, KD
 - AH, 2H, 3H, 4H, 5H, 6H, 7H, 8H, 9H, 10H, JH, QH, KH
 - AS, 2S, 3S, 4S, 5S, 6S, 7S, 8S, 9S, 10S, JS, QS, KS
 - Joker

(A = Ace, J = Jack, Q = Queen, K = King)


-UNO-
 - 0B, 1B, 2B, 3B, 4B, 5B, 6B, 7B, 8B, 9B, P2B, SB, RB
 - 0G, 1G, 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G, 6G, 7G, 8G, 9G, P2G, SG, RG
 - 0R, 1R, 2R, 3R, 4R, 5R, 6R, 7R, 8R, 9R, P2R, SR, RR
 - 0Y, 1Y, 2Y, 3Y, 4Y, 5Y, 6Y, 7Y, 8Y, 9Y, P2Y, SY, RY
 - P4, Wild

(P2 = Pick-up 2, S = Skip, R = Reverse, P4 = Pick-up 4 Wildcard, Wild = Change suit Wildcard)



Card faces can only be seen by the player holding them; to other players (and when in item form) both sides display the back texture, so you don't have to worry about other players seeing your cards!

Textures made by giantSlice "Sice" (me) and compiled by Maxolotl3050 "Max".
